name: 北京大学
character: Built on a Qing-era garden site, the campus blends traditional Chinese architecture and classical gardens with modern Western planning, featuring a southern academic zone and northern lake area.

landmarks.name: 未名湖
landmarks.quote: 燕园的主要景观包括：未名湖、博雅塔、校友门（西门）
landmarks.look: A scenic lake in the northern area of the campus.

landmarks.name: 博雅塔
landmarks.quote: 主轴线连接西门、贝公楼、博雅塔
landmarks.look: A tower situated along the campus's east-west main axis.

landmarks.name: 校友门（西门）
landmarks.quote: 燕园的主要景观包括：未名湖、博雅塔、校友门（西门）
landmarks.look: A campus gate located at the western end of the main axis.

landmarks.name: 贝公楼（办公楼）
landmarks.look: A main office building positioned on the east-west axis.

landmarks.name: 百周年纪念讲堂
landmarks.quote: 新建理科楼群、图书馆新馆、百周年纪念讲堂
landmarks.look: A large auditorium hall used for campus performances.

landmarks.name: 邱德拔体育馆
landmarks.quote: 邱德拔体育馆是北京奥运会乒乓球比赛场馆
landmarks.look: A modern comprehensive sports stadium and gymnasium.

landmarks.name: 图书馆新馆
landmarks.quote: 新建理科楼群、图书馆新馆、百周年纪念讲堂

landmarks.name: 静园
landmarks.look: A garden area formerly serving as women's dormitories.
